project.boundarySource: Curated Corby visitor boundary with reviewed OSM public green-space extensions
project.researchNotes:
Townscape Guides audit completed 2026-08-09. The unchanged ONS 2024 built-up area is the active inclusion boundary. Historic England designations and public current OpenStreetMap visitor facilities were filtered point-in-polygon. Rutland and Northamptonshire standalone attraction audit added 2026-08-09. These regional destinations sit outside the active town boundary, appear only on Home discovery, and do not alter the town tourist rating.

Broad visitor-attraction editorial discovery pass 2026-08-13: expanded See discovery beyond historic records using a local OSM extract. Automatically discovered additions remain below Recommended until source-backed editorial review.

touristAppeal.label: Not a tourist town
touristAppeal.summary: Local culture, industrial history and green spaces do not yet combine into a strong enough visitor experience to recommend Corby as a tourist destination.

townGuide.headline: Steel-town stories, civic culture and useful green spaces

perfectFor: Useful for specific interests, but not currently a tourist town in its own right.

suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Begin with Corby’s heritage story, then add a performance, exhibition or short circuit through the civic centre and boating lake.
